S.FORM: iiku makasi-in ia, tee=pa=ku pu-a-iisua=kani paaraʔəna pu-a-iisua vərəŋa.
S.PHON: iiku makaʂiin ia teepaku puaiisuakani paaraʔəna puaiisua vərəŋa
S.FORM: iiku makasiin ia, teepaku puaiisuakani paara'ena puaiisua verenga.
S.PHON: iiku makaʂiin ia teepaku puaiisuakani paa[r|ɾ]aʔena puaiisua ve[r|ɾ]eŋa
S.TRANSL: I still want to talk about eels now.

S.FORM: nain vanai-n=mita kanakanavu miana kaʔan k<um>a-kaən vərəŋa.
S.PHON: nain vanainmita kanakanavu miana kaʔan kumakaən vərəŋa
S.FORM: nain vanainmita kanakanavu miana ka'an k<um>akaen verenga.
S.PHON: nain vanainmita kanakanavu miana kaʔan kumakaen ve[r|ɾ]eŋa
S.TRANSL: What is the reason for Kanakanavu people not eating eels in the past?

S.FORM: sua vanai-nni ia, makaasə ma-maaraŋ miana.
S.PHON: sua vanainni ia makaasə mamaaraŋ miana
S.FORM: sua vanainni ia, makaase mamaarang miana.
S.PHON: sua vanainni ia makaase mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ miana
S.TRANSL: The reason given by the elders in the past was this.

S.FORM: vanai=mita kanakanavu kaʔan k<um>a-kaən vərəŋa si tee=kita=kani makai vərəŋa mu-a-lavu-lavu vanai si u-cani maamia siu-ini.
S.PHON: vanaimita kanakanavu kaʔan kumakaən vərəŋa ʂi teekitakani makai vərəŋa muaɾavuɾavu vanai ʂi uʦani maamia ʂiuini
S.FORM: vanaimita kanakanavu ka'an k<um>akaen verenga si teekitakani makai verenga muaravuravu vanai si ucani maamia siuini.
S.PHON: vanaimita kanakanavu kaʔan kumakaen ve[r|ɾ]eŋa ʂi teekitakani makai ve[r|ɾ]eŋa mua[r|ɾ]avu[r|ɾ]avu vanai ʂi uʦani maamia ʂiuini
S.TRANSL: The reason we didn't eat eels is that we might resemble eels and feel hungry, having only one intestine.

S.FORM: k<um>a-kaən=kita aa-lala-ʔunsu maamia.
S.PHON: kumakaənkita aaɾaɾaʔunsu maamia
S.FORM: k<um>akaenkita aarara'unsu maamia.
S.PHON: kumakaenkita aa[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]aʔunsu maamia
S.TRANSL: Anything we eat, it would just disappear.

S.FORM: vanai=mita kanakanavu miana kaʔan k<um>a-kaən vərəŋa si vanai-n makaasua.
S.PHON: vanaimita kanakanavu miana kaʔan kumakaən vərəŋa ʂi vanain makaasua
S.FORM: vanaimita kanakanavu miana ka'an k<um>akaen verenga si vanain makaasua.
S.PHON: vanaimita kanakanavu miana kaʔan kumakaen ve[r|ɾ]eŋa ʂi vanain makaasua
S.TRANSL: This is the reason why we Kanakanavu people did not eat eels in the past.

S.FORM: nain nai cəʔəra-i, k<um>aən=kita ia, mu-a-lavu=kia maraʔan vanai maka-sua.
S.PHON: nain nai ʦəʔərai kumaənkita ia muaɾavukia maraʔan vanai makasua
S.FORM: nain nai ce'erai, k<um>aenkita ia, muaravukia mara'an vanai makasua.
S.PHON: nain nai ʦeʔe[r|ɾ]ai kumaenkita ia mua[r|ɾ]avukia ma[r|ɾ]aʔan vanai makasua
S.TRANSL: Look! If we eat (eels), (only we Kanakanavu people) will get hungry very soon. This is probably the reason.

S.FORM: iimu pu-a-iisua=ku iisi si pu-a-kari-kari-au=pa misai. chiausou=maku iisi.
S.PHON: iimu puaiisuaku iiʂi ʂi puakarikariaupa misai ʦhiausoumaku iiʂi
S.FORM: iimu puaiisuaku iisi si puakarikariaupa misai. chiausoumaku iisi.
S.PHON: iimu puaiisuaku iiʂi ʂi puaka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]iaupa misai ʦhiausoumaku iiʂi
S.TRANSL: I'm talking about this because my professor asked me to do so.

S.FORM: sua chiausou=maku iisi ia, lipoŋ=kisai kanakanavu.
S.PHON: sua ʦhiausoumaku iiʂi ia ɾipoŋkisai kanakanavu
S.FORM: sua chiausoumaku iisi ia, ripongkisai kanakanavu.
S.PHON: sua ʦhiausoumaku iiʂi ia [r|ɾ]ipoŋkisai kanakanavu
S.TRANSL: My professor is Japanese, the Kanakanavu term for this is lipuŋ.

S.FORM: ʔaisi na tokio, sua ŋanai-n ia, tsuchida sensei.
S.PHON: ʔaiʂi na tokio sua ŋanain ia tsuʦhi*a sensei
S.FORM: 'aisi na tokio, sua nganain ia, tsuchida sensei.
S.PHON: ʔaiʂi na tokio sua ŋanain ia tsuʦhi*a sensei
S.TRANSL: He lives in Tokyo, and his name is Mr. Tsuchida.

S.FORM: ʔakuni ru-aimi.
S.PHON: ʔakuni ruaimi
S.FORM: 'akuni ruaimi.
S.PHON: ʔakuni [r|ɾ]uaimi

S.FORM: ara-siŋsiŋ-a, susumanpai.
S.PHON: araʂiŋʂiŋa susumanpai
S.FORM: arasingsinga, susumanpai.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aʂiŋʂiŋa susumanpai
